name: blast-radius
description: Stops a command that could lose your work before it runs: deleting files (rm -rf), throwing away unsaved changes or saved versions (git reset, checkout, clean, branch -D), overwriting the shared copy (force push), writing over files, changing or dropping a database, or removing what docker, terraform or kubectl run. It shows exactly what would be lost, then you pick Run anyway or Keep my work; if nobody is there to answer, the command is refused. It also holds an edit to a file another chat just changed, and checks other commands against your own rules in .claude/house-rules.md (English; Turkish with MODZ_LANG=tr).
